Explanatory Notes:
Price & Basis Values quoted are for Current Delivery, unless otherwise noted.
CBOT/KCBT/MGE
 
Trade month symbols
:  F January; G February; H March; J April; K May; M June; N July; Q August; U September; V October; X November; Z December.
Freight Codes: 
 
FOB
: Freight On Board
 
DLVD
: Delivered
 
T
: Truck, 
R
: Rail, 
RB
: River Barge, 
T/R
: Truck/Rail, 
R/B
: Rail/Barge,
 T/R/B
: Truck/Rail/Barge
